Gentle spell minutes
The afternoon briefing began midweek and centered on service readiness, humane handling, and courteous follow-up. Attendees were Aya Osei, Anika Morgan, Murphy, and the team from Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk.

The chair opened with a review of arrival support. <<FACT F107>> Staff agreed that each case should be routed with calm language and a steady hand, so travelers feel informed without delay. The group also noted that records must be kept clear for handoffs and that any concern should be raised through the proper channel.

The next discussion covered booking oversight. <<FACT F097>> The team confirmed that requests should be checked carefully, with respectful updates sent to travelers and to colleagues who need to act. Members reiterated that handlers must use calm, humane methods around animals and preserve a reassuring tone at every stage.

The meeting ended with agreement to continue the present approach and to report any exception promptly.
